title: Bishop Pinned, Bishop Lost
setup: Black's bishop stands on the d-file between your rook and its own king, and your c-pawn is close by.
hint: A pinned bishop cannot step off its line, not even to capture. Attack it with your cheapest piece.
explanation:
## The Idea

The bishop on d7 is pinned to the king on d8 by your rook, so it cannot leave the d-file. {{c6}} attacks it, and the bishop can neither take the pawn nor run away, so {{cxd7}} wins it next move, for a pawn at most.

Taking with the rook would only trade rook for bishop. Attack a pinned piece with the cheapest thing you have.
